# 🎙️ The Aesthetic Edge Podcast  
**Guest Primer for Jodi Melenbacher**  

Hi Jodi! I’m so excited to have you on *The Aesthetic Edge*! This document will give you a quick overview of the podcast, what to expect, and some guiding questions to make our conversation flow smoothly. ✨  

---

## 🌟 About You  
- **Name:** Jodi Melenbacher  
- **Title:** Founder & CEO of *Thrive Wellness* (Chattanooga, TN)  
- **Background:**  
  - 🎓 Family Nurse Practitioner (MSN, NP-C, APN)  
  - ❤️ 6+ years in cardio-thoracic step-down, 10+ years in Aesthetic Medicine  
  - 🧬 Experienced in primary care, functional medicine, medical aesthetics & weight management  
- **Entrepreneurship:**  
  - 🚀 Founded *Thrive Wellness* in 2017 — a MedSpa dedicated to aesthetics + wellness  
  - 📈 Launched a consulting company to help MedSpa owners scale successfully  
  - 💉 Offers injector training + educational courses through *Thrive Wellness Academy*  

---

## 🎯 Podcast Flow  
- **Style:** Casual, conversational, edited (not live)  
- **Length:** ~30–40 minutes  
- **Recording:** Virtual (via Riverside link)  
- **Vibe:** Think coffee chat with a friend ☕ — open, real, and fun

We’ll use these as a guide — we may not get to them all, and that’s okay!
